assessment.rationale: The static analysis provides an authoritative benign prediction from a calibrated model (raw_score 0.216 < threshold 0.832). While the file has high entropy sections and many strings, these are consistent with legitimate Windows GUI applications using dynamic linking and resource tables. limitations: Static analysis cannot confirm runtime behavior or obfuscation techniques that may hide malicious intent.
The prediction model (EMBER feature record) relies on historical patterns rather than raw PE byte analysis alone, though it is treated as authoritative here.
